correctness.rationale: For \(m\ge2\) and \(n\ge3\), the sphere-to-disk/angle factorization and sharp coverage localization imply adjacent-gap simplex conditions. The exact simplex volume gives \(\Pr(E\text{ covered}\mid U)=(S_+/(2\pi))^{n-1}\) and exact Dirichlet independence. Uniform analytic Taylor expansion on compact support, a beta radial integral, and \(L^1\) normalization prove the gamma coefficient, a relative \(O(\varepsilon)\) remainder, and total-variation Beta/direction limit. The independent-sphere sampler and quadrature corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A prescribed great circle is a natural non-arbitrary target between classical random circle arcs and whole-sphere coverage. The exact codimension-dependent onset exponent/coefficient and limiting Beta–Dirichlet configuration measure describe rare near-optimal random covers; the result supplies both a numerical rate and a structural classification of how successful configurations achieve covering. It is not a mere renamed general circle-coverage integral or an unsupported fixed numerical benchmark.
